meta.title: Qingjin research writer
meta.description: A workbench that turns a vague research idea into paper shape: IMRaD / CARS / C-C-C section skeletons, fill-in templates and compilable LaTeX, English phrase templates by section and intent, 75 glossary terms with canonical translations and common mistranslations, paragraph and translation diagnostics, local PDF deep-reading that emits .md + .pdf, online discovery of high-quality papers in the same field, task routing across 18 research stages, and a de-AI prose check. A workbench lives in the right sidebar, opened by the 论文 button beside the composer. Everything runs locally except the field-paper lookup, which QINGJIN_OFFLINE=1 disables entirely. It deliberately does not write the paper for the author.
